Subject: Post-call recap: Redwood platform fit + next steps

Thanks again for taking time this morning, Asha — really appreciated the candid discussion. Quick recap + proposed next steps so we stay aligned: 

Summary of pain / goals
- High cost per inference and variable latency on peak traffic windows impacting user experience.
- Need predictable pricing and ability to run in a VPC for regulated workloads.
- Primary use case: conversational assistant + few-shot summarization for internal support tickets.

How Redwood helps (fit)
- Dedicated serving with predictable throughput + autoscaling to smooth peaks.
- Private deployment option (VPC) and enterprise KMS integrations for data control.
- Cost optimization: batching, KV cache, and quantization recommendations we run in pilot.

Open items we flagged on the call
1) Economic buyer / budget owner — who signs off on platform commits and CAPEX/OPEX?
2) Security and procurement checklist — need to share our SOC2 and security questionnaire.
3) Target timelines and pilot scope (teams, models, expected QPS).

Proposed next steps
- Asha to confirm who the economic buyer / budget owner is (name + email).
- We’ll send a short procurement pack (SOC2, security questionnaire) and a preliminary pricing ballpark for the pilot (attached).
- Rishi (cc) will coordinate a short intro to the budget owner and procurement and follow up on contract timelines.
- Tentative: 30-min technical + commercial sync next week (I proposed Wed/Thu).

Attachments: redwood-pricing-sheet.pdf, redwood-post-call-recap.docx, security-questionnaire.pdf

Thanks — I’ll hold next week slots open.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai | (415) 555-0123
